text:
Elaine: Heads-up — planning a design review for the ML Console + SDK changes (model selector UX, inference-presets, and new auth flow). Looking for a 60-minute slot next week. I put a short pre-read and checklist below. Who can review? :calendar: 

Mike: I can do most mornings Tue–Thu PST. Can we aim for a shorter 45m if we keep focused?

Raj: Tue morning works for me. Also can handle the perf numbers section — I’ll paste p95/p99 for the current baseline.

Elaine: Great — rough proposed slots: 
- Tue 10:00–11:00 PST
- Wed 15:00–16:00 PST
- Thu 09:30–10:30 PST
Please react with "+1" for preferred slot. I’ll close the poll Friday 12:00 PST.

Sophia: I’ll be there for product context; can we add a short UX walk-through (10m) and an API compatibility checklist? :eyes:

Elaine: Yes — agenda below. Pre-read links: 
- API spec: https://redwood.internal/docs/ml-console/api-spec (please read sections 2.1–2.4)
- SDK diff: https://git.redwood/eng/ml-sdk/pull/412
- Mockups: https://figma.com/file/abcd-ml-console

Pre-read / Reviewer checklist (paste into PR description or comment when done):
```
[ ] Read API spec (sections 2.1–2.4) — owner: Sophia
[ ] Review SDK migration notes (breaking changes highlighted) — owner: Mike
[ ] UX mockups & accessibility quick-pass — owner: Sophia
[ ] Performance baseline (p95/p99, tokens/sec) — owner: Raj
[ ] Security & auth flow review (token lifecycle, refresh) — owner: Elaine
[ ] Backwards compatibility/runbook update planned — owner: Mike
[ ] E2E smoke test plan + test owner listed — owner: Raj
```

Raj: Adding perf snippet here as promised: 
`baseline p95 = 120ms, p99 = 310ms` for model-selector path with caching off. With prefix-KV caching we see `p95 = 85ms, p99 = 210ms`. Will include CSV in the doc.

Mike: I skimmed the SDK diff — two things: (1) auth header rename, (2) batch iterator API change. I’ll annotate PR with migration examples.

build-bot: Draft deployment checks passing on staging: `unit: ✅`, `integration: ✅ (smoke)`, `e2e: running` — see https://ci.redwood/builds/9981

Elaine: Thanks — one ask: reviewers please add a single-line ack in the PR once you finish each checklist item (just `ack: perf checked`). Keeps the thread tidy. I’ll schedule the calendar invite once reactions are in.

Sophia: +1 for Tue 10am. I’ll prep a 10-min UX overview and add the API compatibility checklist to the spec.

Mike: +1 Tue 10am. I’ll own SDK migration docs.

Raj: +1 Tue 10am. I’ll upload the perf CSV and test plan by EOD Friday.

Elaine: Perfect — locking Tue 10:00–11:00 PST. Calendar invite incoming. If you can’t make it after invite lands, ping here and we’ll record or do asynchronous reviews. :thumbsup:
